sources: rules/ARCHITECTURE.md in this case folder (layer rule: services receive collaborators through the constructor; only the composition root builds adapters; environment values come from settings, never literals in logic)
Dependency inversion (concept: high-level services depend on injected abstractions; object construction is moved to the composition root)

defects.class: hardcoded host built inside logic instead of injected collaborator
defects.description: Quoted line 32: legacy = InventoryClient(base_url="http://10.20.0.15:8443", timeout_s=5.0) sits inside InventorySync._reconcile_legacy. The service builds its own adapter from a literal environment host and port instead of using the InventoryClient injected through __init__(self, client) at line 14. The host cannot be changed per environment without a code change, the service is not testable with a fake client for this path, and the composition root in main.py is bypassed. Layer rule violated: services receive collaborators through the constructor; environment values come from settings, never literals in logic. Failing input: run() on any settings value; the reconcile pass always targets 10.20.0.15:8443 regardless of INVENTORY_URL.

decoys.why_not_a_defect: Composition root reads settings through Settings.from_env() and builds the client from settings.inventory_url. This is the rule-compliant place for environment values and adapter construction. Only the composition root builds adapters, so this is not a violation.
DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_S is a named constant in the settings module, not a literal inside service logic. Settings is the permitted home for environment-related values. It holds no host or port.
